# 30b30t200dt100int

```{julia}
run_path_init = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/30b30t/30b30t_high/data/param_1_rep_1/"
run_path_cont = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/30b30t/a100t200/30b30t200dt100int_cont1/data/param_1_rep_1"
run_path_cont2 = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/30b30t/a100t200/30b30t200dt100int_cont2/data/param_1_rep_1"
run_path_cont3 = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/checkpoint/30b30t200dt100int_cont3/data/param_1_rep_1"
run_path = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/30b30t/a100t200/"
```

```{julia}
df_init = CSV.read(joinpath(run_path_init, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_init = load_config(joinpath(run_path_init, "config.json"))
df_cont = CSV.read(joinpath(run_path_cont, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_cont = load_config(joinpath(run_path_cont, "config.json"))
df_cont2 = CSV.read(joinpath(run_path_cont2, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_cont2 = load_config(joinpath(run_path_cont2, "config.json"))
df_cont3 = CSV.read(joinpath(run_path_cont3, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_cont3 = load_config(joinpath(run_path_cont3, "config.json"))
```

```{julia}
n_epochs_init = maximum(df_init.epoch)
df_cont.epoch .+= n_epochs_init
df = vcat(df_init, df_cont)
df_cont2.epoch .+= maximum(df_cont.epoch)
df = vcat(df, df_cont2)
df_cont3.epoch .+= maximum(df.epoch)
df = vcat(df, df_cont3)
config = config_init
```

# 20b10t agent removal

```{julia}
init_path = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/plasticity/20b10t/20b10t_init/data/param_1_rep_1"
removal_path = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/checkpoint/20b10t_plastic_agent_removal/data/param_1_rep_2"
df_init = CSV.read(joinpath(init_path, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_init = load_config(joinpath(init_path, "config.json"))
df_rem = CSV.read(joinpath(removal_path, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_rem = load_config(joinpath(removal_path, "config.json"))
```

```{julia}
df = CSV.read(joinpath(init_path, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config = load_config(joinpath(init_path, "config.json"))
```

```{julia}
ss_rem = subset(
    df_rem,
    :epoch => ByRow(x -> x == 0),
    :accuracies => ByRow(x -> x >= 0.8)
)
println(unique(ss_rem.bee_id))
```

```{julia}
max_epoch_init = maximum(df_init.epoch)
ss_init = subset(
    df_init,
    :epoch => ByRow(x -> x == max_epoch_init),
    :accuracies => ByRow(x -> x >= 0.8)
)
println(unique(ss_init.bee_id))
```

```{julia}
max_epoch_rem = maximum(df_rem.epoch)
ss_final = subset(
    df_rem,
    :epoch => ByRow(x -> x == max_epoch_rem),
    :accuracies => ByRow(x -> x >= 0.8)
)
println(unique(ss_final.bee_id))
```

```{julia}
df = df_init
config = config_init
bee_rank = [1,2,3,9,10,12,13,15,17,20,4,5,6,7,8,11,14,16,18,19]
M = maximum(df.task_id)
```

```{julia}
df_rem2 = copy(df_rem)
df_rem2.epoch .+= maximum(df_init.epoch)
df = vcat(df_init, df_rem2)
df = df_rem
config = config_init
bee_rank = [1,2,3,9,10,12,13,15,17,20,4,5,6,7,8,11,14,16,18,19]
M = maximum(df.task_id)
order = [5,2,3,4,1,6,7,8,9,10]
```

# 15b10t agent removal
```{julia}
init_path = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/checkpoint/15b10t_init_sweep/data/param_2_rep_6/"
rem_path = "/project/theorie/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/results_project/checkpoint/15b10t100dt200int_plastic4/data/param_1_rep_1"
df_init = CSV.read(joinpath(init_path, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_init = load_config(joinpath(init_path, "config.json"))
df_rem = CSV.read(joinpath(rem_path, "states.csv"), DataFrame)
config_rem = load_config(joinpath(rem_path, "config.json"))
```
## first plot
```{julia}
df = df_init
config = config_init
order = [1,8,3,4,7,6,5,2,9,10]
bee_rank = [2, 6, 8, 10, 7, 5, 14, 13, 15, 12, 11, 4, 3, 9, 1] # first 6 remain good, the next 4 were good but were removed
```

# second plot
```{julia}
df = df_init
config = config_init
tasks_that_lost_their_best_agent = [1, 5, 8, 9, 10]
agents_to_remove = [14, 13, 15, 12]
df = subset(
    df,
    :bee_id => ByRow(x -> x ∉ agents_to_remove)
)
order = [1,8,3,4,7,6,5,2,9,10]
bee_rank = [2,6,8,10,7,5, 1,3,4,9]
```

# third plot
```{julia}
order = [1,8,3,4,7,6,5,2,9,10]
bee_rank = [2,6,8,10,7,5, 1,3,4,9]

    df_init,
    :bee_id => ByRow(x -> x ∉ agents_to_remove)
)

df_rem2.epoch .+= maximum(df_init.epoch)
df = vcat(ss, df_rem2)

```
